title: Redox and Electrochemistry - Redox Reactions and Electrochemistry - Oxidation Numbers
subject: Redox Reactions and Electrochemistry

questions.q: What is the oxidation number of sulfur (S) in sulfuric acid, $H_2SO_4$?
questions.explain:
In $H_2SO_4$: H is +1 (total +2), O is -2 (total -8). Let S be $x​$. 
$$2(+1) + x + 4(-2) = 0$$
$$2 + x - 8 = 0 \Rightarrow x = +6$$
questions.subject: Redox Reactions and Electrochemistry

questions.q: Determine the oxidation state of manganese (Mn) in the permanganate ion, $MnO_4^-$.
questions.explain:
In $MnO_4^-$: O is -2 (total -8). The overall charge is -1. 
$$x + 4(-2) = -1$$
$$x - 8 = -1 \Rightarrow x = +7$$
questions.subject: Redox Reactions and Electrochemistry

questions.q: What is the oxidation number of oxygen in hydrogen peroxide, $H_2O_2$?
questions.explain:
Peroxides are a major exception to the oxygen rule. In $H_2O_2$, H is +1, so: 
$$2(+1) + 2x = 0 \Rightarrow 2x = -2 \Rightarrow x = -1$$
questions.subject: Redox Reactions and Electrochemistry

questions.q: Calculate the oxidation number of chromium (Cr) in the dichromate ion, $Cr_2O_7^{2-}$.
questions.explain:
In $Cr_2O_7^{2-}$: O is -2 (total -14). Overall charge is -2. 
$$2x + 7(-2) = -2$$
$$2x - 14 = -2 \Rightarrow 2x = +12 \Rightarrow x = +6$$
questions.subject: Redox Reactions and Electrochemistry

questions.q: What is the oxidation number of nitrogen in the ammonium ion, $NH_4^+$?
questions.explain:
In $NH_4^+$: H is +1 (total +4). Overall charge is +1. 
$$x + 4(+1) = +1$$
$$x + 4 = +1 \Rightarrow x = -3$$
questions.subject: Redox Reactions and Electrochemistry

questions.q: What is the oxidation number of chlorine in elemental chlorine gas, $Cl_2$?
questions.explain: The oxidation number of an atom in its elemental form (uncombined with other elements) is always **0**.
questions.subject: Redox Reactions and Electrochemistry

questions.q: In the compound $FeCl_3$, what is the oxidation number of iron (Fe)?
questions.explain:
Chlorine (a halogen) usually has an oxidation number of -1. 
$$x + 3(-1) = 0 \Rightarrow x = +3$$

questions.q:
Which element undergoes a change in oxidation number from +5 to +2 in the reaction:
$$3Cu + 8HNO_3 \rightarrow 3Cu(NO_3)_2 + 2NO + 4H_2O$$
questions.explain: Nitrogen in $HNO_3$ is +5. In $NO$ (product), nitrogen is +2 (since O is -2). Thus, Nitrogen changes from +5 to +2.
